This read decodes the owner-field flags varint. Because the saved UBSan crash lands in the first owner-name branch at line 1360, the resulting `flags` state necessarily satisfies `(flags & OWNER_USER_NAME) != 0` on the witnessed path.

On the crashing path, the parsed user-name length is large enough that this code leaves `name_len == OWNER_MAXNAMELEN`. The later terminator store at line 1360 therefore targets index 256 of `namebuf[256]`. The staged patch fixes the exact obligation by changing the threshold to `>= OWNER_MAXNAMELEN` and truncating to `OWNER_MAXNAMELEN - 1` before the terminator write.
